title: Caitlin Long: Fiscal Dominance, Stablecoins & the Macro Case for Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Caitlin Long: Fiscal Dominance, Stablecoins & the Macro Case for Bitcoin Will tokenized deposits crowd out stablecoins? Custodia Bank's Caitlin Long explains why bringing tokenization to traditional banks is the bigger story. This post Caitlin Long: Fiscal Dominance, Stablecoins & the Macro Case for Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
